t: This is 4 Marylebone Mews, a building in Westminster. It was commissioned by Thomas Woolner, who was both a sculptor and a poet. Woolner matters because he was one of the founding members of the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood, and he was the only sculptor among its original members. So this modest mews address connects to a group best known for painters, with a sculptor at its core. The material I have on the building itself is thin, so I'll leave it there.
